Topics · Hard times

Why listen to faith when believers hurt me?

You are not asked to listen. What happened stays a serious reason, and no one here defends those who did it.

Part 1 of 3

﴿بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَـٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Certainly has Allāh heard the speech of the one who argues [i.e., pleads] with you, [O Muḥammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allāh. And Allāh hears your dialogue; indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.

Quran · Al-Mujadilah 58:1

Translation

I cry with my voice to Yahweh. With my voice, I ask Yahweh for mercy. I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles. When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.

Original · Hebrew

ק֭וֹלִי אֶל־יְהוָ֣ה אֶזְעָ֑ק ק֝וֹלִ֗י אֶל־יְהוָ֥ה אֶתְחַנָּֽן׃ אֶשְׁפֹּ֣ךְ לְפָנָ֣יו שִׂיחִ֑י צָ֝רָתִ֗י לְפָנָ֥יו אַגִּֽיד׃ בְּהִתְעַטֵּ֬ף עָלַ֨י ׀ רוּחִ֗י וְאַתָּה֮ יָדַ֪עְתָּ נְֽתִיבָ֫תִ֥י בְּאֹֽרַח־ז֥וּ אֲהַלֵּ֑ךְ טָמְנ֖וּ פַ֣ח לִֽי׃

the Psalms · 142:1-3

World English Bible

You may not need to listen at all, and that comes first. Nothing here is owed. What was done to you is a fact and needs no one's permission to count. If an old text deserves a moment, it is only for this: a woman disputed with the messenger over her husband, and took her complaint to God. The account does not begin by correcting her. It begins by saying that she was heard.

A question for you

Which is closest to what you want right now?

If you sayTo be left alone with it.
ThenThat is yours to choose, and nothing changes if you stop here. Everything after this is optional.
If you sayTo say it without being corrected.
ThenThis app cannot hear you or reach anyone for you, but nothing here will correct you. If it is still happening, please go to someone you trust or to help where you live.
If you sayTo know whether anyone in that world has admitted this.
ThenThat is what comes next, and you will judge whether it is enough.

Part 2 of 3

﴿لَّا يُحِبُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْجَهْرَ بِٱلسُّوٓءِ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ إِلَّا مَن ظُلِمَ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ سَمِيعًا عَلِيمًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

Allāh does not like the public mention of evil except by one who has been wronged. And ever is Allāh Hearing and Knowing.

Quran · An-Nisa 4:148

Translation

If you take advantage of them at all, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry;

Original · Hebrew

אִם־עַנֵּ֥ה תְעַנֶּ֖ה אֹת֑וֹ כִּ֣י אִם־צָעֹ֤ק יִצְעַק֙ אֵלַ֔י שָׁמֹ֥עַ אֶשְׁמַ֖ע צַעֲקָתֽוֹ׃

the Torah (Exodus) · 22:23

World English Bible

Communities often protect themselves by asking the injured to keep quiet: for the family's name, for the faith's name, for the sake of peace. This text goes the other way. It says public talk of evil is disliked, and it makes one exception: the person who was wronged. So silence was never owed. Anyone who told you that your speaking would harm the religion was asking for something this text does not ask.

A question for you

Which does more damage to a religion's name?

If you sayThe one who did the harm.
ThenThen the one who speaks of the harm is not what damages the name. The damage came first.
If you sayThe one who silenced the victim.
ThenThen silencing in religion's name does the opposite of what it claims, which is what the exception says.
If you sayI no longer care about its name.
ThenThat makes sense, and you are not asked to care. No one here wants you to guard anything's reputation.

Part 3 of 3

﴿فَوَيْلٌ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ٤ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ٥ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ٦ وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ٧﴾

Translation of the meaning

So woe to those who pray [But] who are heedless of their prayer[2000] - Those who make show [of their deeds] And withhold [simple] assistance.

Translator's notes

[2000] i.e., the hypocrites who are unconcerned if they miss prayers when no one sees them.

Quran · Al-Ma'un 107:4-7

Translation

My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

Original · Ancient Greek

Τεκνία, μὴ ἀγαπῶμεν λόγῳ μηδὲ τῇ γλώσσῃ ἀλλὰ ἐν ἔργῳ καὶ ἀληθείᾳ.

1 John · 3:18

World English Bible

﴿يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لِمَ تَقُولُونَ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ٢ كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَن تَقُولُوا۟ مَا لَا تَفْعَلُونَ٣﴾

Translation of the meaning

O you who have believed, why do you say what you do not do? Greatly hateful in the sight of Allāh is that you say what you do not do.

Quran · As-Saff 61:2-3

Translation

All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don’t do their works; for they say, and don’t do.

Original · Ancient Greek

πάντα οὖν ὅσα ἐὰν εἴπωσιν ὑμῖν ποιήσατε καὶ τηρεῖτε, κατὰ δὲ τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν μὴ ποιεῖτε, λέγουσιν γὰρ καὶ οὐ ποιοῦσιν.

the Gospel (Matthew) · 23:3

World English Bible

Here is what can honestly be said, and it is limited. Some of the sharpest language in this tradition is aimed at the religious themselves. One short passage turns on people who perform their prayers for show and withhold small kindnesses. Another asks believers why they say what they do not do. That does not repair anything. It does not make those people less responsible or the institution less guilty. It means only that your charge is not foreign to the text. It is already there.

A question for you

What would you need from that world, if anything?

If you sayAn admission that it happened.
ThenThat is a fair thing to ask. An app cannot give it in anyone's name. It can only say that such things have happened.
If you sayTo see someone live what they say.
ThenThat is the text's own standard, and you may apply it to the text and to this app.
If you sayNothing. I am done with it.
ThenThat is yours to decide. Nothing here will follow you.
If you sayTo know what they would say about me now.
ThenThis app passes judgment on no one. There is a whole question on that, if you want it.

James · 1:21-22

World English Bible

Translation
